checkpoints.description: [1/2] Plan and add deterministic score transposition

impact_assessment.why: Changing key currently means hand-editing every pitch; a transpose operation makes the compiler useful for arrangement.
impact_assessment.benefits: A single --semitones option shifts every pitched note while preserving timing, velocity, pan and envelopes; round-trip by inverse transpose is byte-identical.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: rests and non-pitch fields must be untouched and golden vectors unchanged when the option is absent; dependency: std only; concurrency: none; state: none.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Add a pure transpose module with note-level tests, apply it at one point after composition, add inverse-transpose byte-equivalence tests, then run cargo gates and aikit check --strict.

checkpoints.description: 5/5 AIKit gates passed; 78 tests green; inverse transposition restores byte-identical audio and CLI semitone routing verified
Task 'coda-transpose' completed successfully.

checkpoints.description: [1/1] Restore --wave override for parsed scores

impact_assessment.why: After notes gained their own wave field, --wave only changed the score default, so render from a file ignored it.
impact_assessment.benefits: The documented --wave override works again for render, digest and export-score, not just seed.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: seed behavior already correct and must stay; dependency: std only; concurrency: none; state: none.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Propagate the override to every note as well as the score default, add a byte-level regression test, and rerun all gates.

checkpoints.description: 5/5 AIKit gates passed; 79 tests green; --wave override now reaches parsed notes and is pinned by a byte-level CLI test
Task 'coda-wave-override-fix' completed successfully.

checkpoints.description: [1/2] Plan and add seeded score variation

impact_assessment.why: A single score can only be heard one way; a deterministic variation command turns it into a family of related pieces without manual editing.
impact_assessment.benefits: vary applies bounded, seeded changes to pitch, velocity, pan and timbre; amount 0 is an exact identity; the result is an ordinary editable score.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: amount 0 must return a byte-identical Score and all varied fields must stay in valid ranges; dependency: std only; concurrency: none; state: none.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Add a pure vary module with identity/determinism/bounds tests, a CLI command routing to canonical .coda output, then run cargo gates and aikit check --strict.

checkpoints.description: 5/5 AIKit gates passed; 85 tests green; seeded variation is byte-identical for equal seeds, identity at amount 0, and output re-parses cleanly
Task 'coda-vary' completed successfully.
checkpoints.head: e1118522fbc18f01e0e7022dd974b813b620c36b

checkpoints.description: [1/2] Plan and add a structural and byte-level score comparison command

impact_assessment.why: After variation and transposition there can be many similar scores; telling what actually changed requires a repeatable comparison.
impact_assessment.benefits: compare reports structural differences and whether the rendered audio is byte-identical, in a stable ordering suitable for tests and scripts.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: compare must be read-only, never fail on differences, and keep exact output ordering; dependency: std only; concurrency: none; state: none.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Add a pure compare module with exact-vector tests and a CLI command reading two score files, then run cargo gates and aikit check --strict.

checkpoints.description: 5/5 AIKit gates passed; 90 tests green; compare output pinned byte-for-byte for identical and differing scores
Task 'coda-compare' completed successfully.
checkpoints.head: c435d33b5d5b9caedfdb3620b0f36dac754c634c

checkpoints.description: [1/2] Plan and add MIDI import for the type-0 subset Coda exports

impact_assessment.why: Coda could write MIDI but not read it back, so an exported piece could not be edited or compared as a score again.
impact_assessment.benefits: import-midi reconstructs tempo, pitches, timing and velocities from a single-track MIDI file, closing the symbolic round-trip.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: unsupported formats or running-status violations must fail with a clear message and never panic; dependency: std only; concurrency: none; state: none.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Write a bounds-checked parser with error tests, add byte-vector round-trip tests through export then import, then run cargo gates and aikit check --strict.

checkpoints.description: 5/5 AIKit gates passed; 96 tests green; supported-subset MIDI round-trip preserves byte-identical audio and richer scores report their non-MIDI losses via compare
Task 'coda-midi-import' completed successfully.
checkpoints.head: af500fa90af051f7adf20d9f480fd61fdffc6014

checkpoints.description: [1/2] Plan and add format-1 multi-track MIDI import

impact_assessment.why: Real MIDI files from DAWs are usually format 1 with a tempo track and separate note tracks; Coda only accepted format 0.
impact_assessment.benefits: Notes from all tracks merge into one deterministic Score while tempo meta events are honored from any track.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: existing format-0 imports must stay byte-identical; dependency: std only; concurrency: none; state: none.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Refactor track parsing to return notes and tempo separately, merge and sort deterministically, add a multi-track byte fixture test, then run cargo gates and aikit check --strict.

checkpoints.description: 5/5 AIKit gates passed; 99 tests green; format-1 conductor and note tracks merge into one score with tempo and deterministic note order
Task 'coda-multitrack-midi' completed successfully.
